A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Good questions.
Honest answers.

How do you choose creators?

We start with the customer profile and campaign objective. Then we review creators’ audience demographics, location, interests, average views, engagement quality, authenticity and compatibility with the brand.

Do you work only with large creators?

No. We consider creators based on audience relevance and campaign fit. The right choice may have a smaller, highly relevant audience or a broader following that still aligns with your customers.

Can you guarantee campaign results?

No. Campaign outcomes depend on the product, creative, audience, platform and many other factors. We agree on objectives and measurement, then report the available evidence without promising a fixed outcome.

What do you need to get started?

A little context about your brand, product, ideal customer, target locations, campaign objective, budget and timeline. We use this to begin a focused discussion.
